articles.summary: Guardian Pharmacy Services has expanded its presence in Tennessee and Kentucky through the acquisition of Van’s Institutional Pharmacy, a long-term care (LTC) pharmacy based in Martin, Tennessee. The addition grows Guardian’s Tennessee operations to five pharmacies in Memphis, Shelbyville, Murfreesboro, Knoxville, and Martin, strengthening its ability to meet increasing demand for LTC pharmacy services across
articles.title: Guardian Pharmacy Services Acquires Van’s Institutional Pharmacy, Expanding Footprint in Tennessee and Kentucky
